=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:757-761 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The staging loop runs `rm -f` on the checkout helper (759-760), but the reroute (`git checkout --quiet -f -B "${base_ref}" FETCH_HEAD`, 1466-1470) brings back a base-branch-tracked `scripts/plan_base_ci_gate.sh`, and auto_approve (3743-3745) then sources it.
  WHY: In a reroute run where the support ref lacks the helper, checkout code can run in the step that holds `GH_TOKEN` and `AI_COMMENT_SIGNING_SECRET`. Both reviewers rated it MAJOR (mapped to high). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same path only as a hardening suggestion (risk score 1).
- scripts/plan_base_ci_gate.sh:282-287 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new `::warning::` in the red_base_approval_hold_comment else-branch fires when the comments read fails, but `2>/dev/null` discards the gh/jq stderr, so the warning gives no cause.
  WHY: When duplicate hold comments appear, operators cannot tell rate limit, auth loss, a network blip or a JSON-shape change apart. Behaviour stays fail-open (the comment is still posted). Both reviewers rated it NIT (mapped to low). openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised it as hardening only.
- tests/test_plan_base_ci_gate.py:329-341 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: test_helper_is_staged_from_the_workflow_source only asserts strings in the staging-loop YAML and never runs it. _run_step copies the helper in directly (line 117), so the `rm -f`, `.codex-workflow-src-main` fallback and `install -m 0755` paths are never exercised.
  WHY: A regression in the removal or fallback logic, or swapped `install`/`rm -f` order, would pass CI and could leave a foreign helper to be sourced by the secret-bearing auto_approve step. Both reviewers rated it NIT (mapped to low). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 raised it as hardening only.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]

The disclosure exists only in changelog.d/stuck-backlog-phase2-red-base-hold.md ("Not in this change: a red-base check on the poller's own stall-recovery approval"), agents.d/stuck-backlog-phase2-red-base-hold.md ("Release path") and the hold comment text at plan.yml:3754. Severity disagreement: MAJOR (gemini, minimax), NIT (sonnet, luna, glm).
- requirement: "Add a contract test, `tests/test_plan_base_ci_gate.py`, covering: red → hold ... green → approve unchanged ... the kill switch off → legacy behaviour ... unreadable status → the plan's chosen fail mode"
  expected_change_site: `tests/test_plan_base_ci_gate.py` (staging loop coverage)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The tests copy the helper into a temp dir by hand. No test runs the `plan.yml` staging loop to confirm that a missing or mismatching source removes the checkout copy.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- HARDENING: .github/workflows/plan.yml | "Stage workflow support files", the plan_base_ci_gate.sh loop at lines 758-761, together with the merged_check_not_passed reroute at lines 1466-1470
  PROBLEM: When no helper is staged, the loop runs `rm -f`, but the reroute's `git checkout --quiet -f -B "${base_ref}" FETCH_HEAD` can restore a base-tracked copy. The tar step uses `--ignore-failed-read`, so it skips the deleted path, and auto_approve (3743-3745) then sources the restored copy.
  WHY: This needs a support ref without the helper, a consumer that tracks a file with that exact name, and a reroute. It matters only until the helper reaches @stable. Fix: write `PLAN_BASE_CI_GATE_STAGED=false` to GITHUB_ENV, then run `rm -f` after the reroute's `tar -xf` (~3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- HARDENING: tests/test_plan_base_ci_gate.py | test_helper_is_staged_from_the_workflow_source
  PROBLEM: The test only checks strings and never runs the staging loop.
  WHY: The test would still pass if the `rm -f` branch or the main-snapshot fallback broke. Fix: run the sliced loop body in bash in a temp dir, covering the absent-source and present-source cases (~10 lines).
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "If the plan's release path needs poller changes, implement only the plan.yml/helper side here and say so in the PR body."
  Expected change site: the PR description (the poller-side deferral note)
  Evidence of absence: The PR description does not mention the left-out poller-side red-base check or that stall recovery (`_plan_auto_approval_gate`, orchestrate_poll_process.sh:26463) can approve before the base is green. This is written only in the changelog.d and agents.d fragments. The code side is deferred correctly.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- NOTE: The reviewer rejected minimax's pass-1 claim that the structural-only staging test is a high-severity defect (downgraded to hardening). It also did not report the stderr-less warning, calling it a logging nit with no runtime change.
